sources.claim: A2A Protocol surpasses 150 supporting organizations at one-year mark; production deployments confirmed in Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Salesforce Agentforce; 22,000+ GitHub stars
Google announces Agent2Agent Protocol on April 9, 2025 with 50+ founding partners including Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Atlassian, PayPal, and LangChain
Google donates A2A to Linux Foundation on June 23, 2025; AWS, Cisco, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, SAP, and ServiceNow named as founding members
A2A one-year anniversary retrospective: 22,000+ GitHub stars, stable v1.0 milestone, and confirmed production deployments at enterprise scale
Global AI Agents market size: USD 7.84 billion in 2025, projected USD 52.62 billion by 2030, registering CAGR of 46.3%
Gartner forecasts agentic AI software spend at $201.9B in 2026; supply chain management software with agentic AI to reach $53B in spend by 2030
Official press release confirming A2A one-year milestone; vertical adoption spans supply chain, financial services, insurance, and IT operations
'a2a protocol' search volume grew 52% quarter-over-quarter and 22% month-over-month per DataForSEO April 2026 data
EU AI Act transparency rules came into effect August 2026; high-risk AI systems (including autonomous financial and medical agents) require auditability, human oversight, and conformity assessment
AI agent ecosystem converging on four complementary protocols: A2A (Google), MCP (Anthropic), ACP (IBM), ANP (community). MCP crossed 97M monthly SDK downloads (Python + TypeScript) by February 2026
40% of enterprise applications projected to include task-specific AI agents by end of 2026, up from less than 5% in 2025 (Gartner/Belitsoft)
Salesforce Agentforce grew from launch to $1.2B ARR in 18 months; ServiceNow Now Assist crossed $1B ARR in 14 months — both powered by A2A-compatible agent infrastructure
